articles.title: Bitcoin heads for sixth weekly loss as Anthropic’s blockbuster IPO looms
articles.snippet: Bitcoin is down 21% this year as investors weigh Anthropic’s anticipated listing, Nvidia’s leadership upheaval and rising Fed rate hike expectations.

articles.title: Live updates: Bitcoin eyes bear market lows as late summer rally mostly wiped out
articles.snippet: Equity markets are falling as well, with interest rates and the dollar surging amid an increasingly hawkish Federal Reserve.

articles.title: SpaceX-Tesla merger talks put 30,000 bitcoin back in focus
articles.snippet: A deal could be announced as soon as December, putting $2.1 billion of bitcoin under one roof, a sliver of what the combined group would be worth.

articles.title: Illinois crypto tax is impossible to enforce as written, crypto industry tells court
articles.snippet: The legal battle to head off the crypto transaction tax in Illinois has drawn up a hefty roster of industry opposition, and they're saying the tax won't work.

articles.title: Jupiter adds Anchorage-backed USDGO to its $1 billion Solana lending platform
articles.snippet: OSL offers a yield on USDGO only to professional investors, but Jupiter said its market lets other holders earn onchain at rates set by borrower demand.
